title: What Water Currency Pilots Is
definition: Water Currency Pilots: water rights as tradable currency.
description:
Water Currency Pilots: water rights as tradable currency. This is Post-Scarcity Economy at its most ambitious — water ledgers research, pilot logistics engineering and scarcity pricing operations converging on a single goal: making pilot hulls real.

Why it matters: Post-Scarcity Economy will decide equity guards outcomes this century. Water Currency Pilots is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working pilot hulls, the larger water ledgers vision stalls, and with it, the pilot logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Water Currency Pilots in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

title: Real Research Today: Water Currency Pilots
definition: Today's documented research behind Water Currency Pilots.
description:
The road to Water Currency Pilots is already being paved. Open-source hardware (Arduino, RISC-V) shows zero-marginal-cost production at scale. The Doughnut Economics model (Kate Raworth, Amsterdam) reframes growth within planetary bounds.

Elinor Ostrom's Nobel-winning work on governing the commons underpins commons economics. Together these programs form the water ledgers foundation that Water Currency Pilots will build on — the pilot logistics results, the scarcity pricing methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as pilot logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Water Currency Pilots
definition: Estimates Water Currency Pilots readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Water Currency Pilots components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a pilot hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Water Currency Pilots operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Water Currency Pilots installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 41548 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where water ledgers monitoring, pilot logistics redundancy, or scarcity pricing maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Water Currency Pilots Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Water Currency Pilots: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Water Currency Pilots — water rights as tradable currency.

Phase 1 — Prove (water ledgers): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (pilot logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (scarcity pricing): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (equity guards): pilot hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and basins-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
